notes.note: Edited for review round 2 of #4279: issuer required with any client ID (public mix-up rationale), optional issuer pinning registration, writer-wide enforcement including registry installs/imports, RFC 9207 iss checks, and a precise Known limit for DCR without a declared issuer when the honest server omits iss. Checked against tool-server-oauth.ts, integration-oauth-client-invariants.ts and the round-2 tests (mix-up, RFC 9207, registry route, install helper).
